meta_title: The Hope & Anchor | Traditional Pub Bristol
meta_description: The Hope & Anchor, Bristol — a welcoming traditional pub on Jacob's Wells Road serving real ales, hearty food, and community spirit. Visit us today.
hero_subhead: Real ales, proper food, and a warm welcome waiting for you in the heart of Clifton every single day.
services_heading: What You'll Find at The Hope & Anchor
services_subhead: From morning coffee to evening pints, we've got everything a proper local pub should offer.

services.title: Real Ales & Craft Beers
services.desc: Twelve rotating taps featuring local Bristol breweries and classic real ales. Ask our staff for recommendations — we know every pint.

services.title: Hearty Pub Food
services.desc: Fresh-cooked specials every day, from pies and pints to vegetarian dishes. All made in-house using quality ingredients.

services.title: Private Function Space
services.desc: Upstairs room available for birthdays, work dos, and celebrations. Flexible menus and competitive group rates.

services.title: Outdoor Garden Terrace
services.desc: Dog-friendly beer garden with covered seating. Perfect for sunny afternoons or catching the game outdoors.

services.title: Quiz Nights & Live Music
services.desc: Regular Thursday quizzes and weekend live music from local performers. Check our socials for this month's schedule.

services.title: Weekday Lunch Menu
services.desc: Quick, honest food at fair prices from noon. Ideal if you work nearby or want a proper pub lunch without the fuss.

about_pullquote: We're here because Bristol deserves a proper pub, not a chain.
about_para_1: The Hope & Anchor has been part of Jacob's Wells Road since 1987. We started as a neighbourhood local and we've stayed that way — independent, family-run, and proud to be a real community hub in Clifton. Over nearly four decades, we've built friendships and watched this corner of Bristol change, all while keeping one foot firmly in the past.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is straightforward: we care about the people who walk through our door. We pour proper pints from real ales you won't find everywhere, cook real food in our kitchen, and make sure regulars and newcomers alike feel at home. That's why people keep coming back.

reviews.text: Best real ale selection in Clifton. Been coming here for years and the staff always remembers what you drink. The upstairs room is perfect for groups — had my 40th here last month and it was brilliant. Proper pub, proper people.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Stumbled in on a Saturday and felt instantly welcome. Dog-friendly garden, great beer, and the specials board looked amazing. Food came out hot and honestly cooked. Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: This is what a local pub should be. No frills, no pretence, just good beer, good food, and good company. The quiz night is always a laugh. Love this place.
reviews.author: James W.
